edits.before: AP assassins picked the wrong statue — taunt the dive, shield the burst, and watch the assassination become community service.
edits.after: Death Lotus is a channel and you carry three separate interrupts — taunt her, knock her up, or land R, and the ultimate goes nowhere.

edits.before: Taunt the dive and let the shield do the arguing — AP assassins fund your lane. Every commit starts with one question: is Shunpo down?
edits.after: Hold W and E for her Shunpo, not for the wave — she blinks 725 units in on a 12-second cooldown and one taunt ends the reset chain.

edits.before: Katarina wins by landing Shunpo, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Katarina wins by getting a kill anywhere — Voracity refunds her cooldowns, and a reset chain does not care that you built magic resist.

edits.before: Q the contact, let the tornado tick, E-auto if he answers, W-taunt the commit — a full rotation where his half landed on a shield.
edits.after: Q the contact, let the tornado tick, E in while Shunpo is down, W-taunt on landing — her blink is 12s at rank 1 and that is your window.

edits.before: Charging W through a minion line at a mage holding his answer — the statue mid-charge is the lane's easiest skillshot target.
edits.after: Charging W while she still holds Shunpo — the charge slows you, she blinks 725 units behind you, and the taunt releases onto nothing.

edits.before: Ahead, tax both maps: zone Katarina with taunt threat, keep the wave middle, and R every skirmish — fed Galio makes the enemy jungler unemployed.
edits.after: Ahead, starve Voracity: her resets need a kill, so never leave a low-health target near her, keep the wave middle, and punish every dagger she throws.

edits.before: - Katarina Shunpo: matchup-defining — Her blink to daggers and targets — hard CC during her resets and she folds. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Shield of Durand for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Shunpo is 12s at rank 1 and 8s at rank 5, 725 range — step up on its downtime, never into it. - Death Lotus is 75s at rank 1 and a channel: your 18s taunt or your 11s knockup cancels it outright, so keep one of the two held.

edits.before: Shield-trade the contacts and taunt the over-steps — your lane is a toll booth for magic damage.
edits.after: Her daggers do the damage, not her autos — stand off the dagger she throws and the trade never starts.

edits.before: Best wave: a Q-cleared middle wave that keeps your R timer flexible — Galio waves are about being free to leave. Worst wave: a hard-shoved wave when your bot lane is fighting — the R you couldn't channel is the fight your team lost. Crash timing: every crash should buy something — a reset, a plate, a roam. Autopilot shoving buys ganks.
edits.after: Best wave: a wave held middle, where her 625-range Bouncing Blade has to come to you to hit anything. Worst wave: a wave shoved to her tower, where she Shunpos a minion at 725 range and is gone before the taunt lands. Crash timing: crash while Shunpo is on cooldown, so the reset she wants during your recall never gets set up.

edits.after: Good trade: Q the contact, let the tornado tick, E in while Shunpo is down, W-taunt on landing — her blink is 12s at rank 1 and that is your window. edits.before: Level 3 taunt rotations tax commits; level 6 makes you a map event; first item turns AP lanes into subscriptions.
edits.after: Level 3 taunt rotations cancel her dives; level 6 makes you a map event; her spike is any kill that triggers Voracity.

edits.before: If Katarina takes first blood, tighten up: Shunpo is now always up in your head. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm with Q clears and stay relevant through taunt peel and R arrivals.
edits.after: If Katarina takes first blood, Voracity hands her cooldowns straight back — stop contesting daggers and farm instead. A second kill ends the duel, not the game: clear with Q, peel with the taunt, and arrive with R.

edits.before: Carry through arrivals — Hero's Entrance turns every losing skirmish your team starts into a 5v4 with a knockup.
edits.after: Carry by peeling — your taunt and your R knockup both cancel Death Lotus, so stand beside the carry she wants to reset on.

edits.before: You are the anti-dive: taunt their engage off your carry, shield the magic, and R the flank their comp built around.
edits.after: You are the anti-reset: taunt her off the carry, knock up the Death Lotus, and deny the kill that refunds her whole kit.

edits.before: Her blink to daggers and targets — hard CC during her resets and she folds. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.

edits.after: Q the dagger she wants to reset

edits.after: Bouncing Blade leaves a dagger on the ground for her reset — your Q covers that ground from 825 range, outside her 625 reach.

edits.before: Hold E as the gap answer vs AD kits

edits.before: Katarina whiffs Shunpo and the lane briefly belongs to you.

edits.before: That is Katarina’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.

edits.before: Trade AD lethality spikes at even HP

edits.before: Your R locks you in place mid-channel — casting it without the wave parked is donating two waves and a tower.
edits.after: Every dagger on the ground is a Shunpo target and a free Voracity slash — step off them before you commit.
